judgments.en_span: (a) the Vendor having obtained all necessary third party consents in respect of the Acquisition;
judgments.zh_span: (a) 賣方已就收購事項取得所有必要的第三方同意；
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same condition: the Vendor must obtain all necessary third-party consents for the Acquisition.

judgments.en_span: (b) no material adverse change in the business of the Target having occurred;
judgments.zh_span: (b) 目標公司業務並無發生重大不利變動；
judgments.explanation: Both passages express the same condition: no material adverse change in the Target's business has occurred.
